needed.evidence: The area between the gas station and the road is an unpaved, informal strip, not a continuous sidewalk.
needed.suggestion: Construct a paved, continuous sidewalk along the left side to provide a safe, defined path for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: There is a commercial area (gas station) on the left with no visible pedestrian crossing facility nearby.

needed.suggestion: Include a central refuge island in any new crossing to allow pedestrians to cross the wide road in two stages.
